citations.claim: The persona configuration defines metadata including name, description, type, engine, and prompt file location
The persona provides structured engineering workflow guidance with five primary goals
Engineering workflow includes research-first approach, explicit planning, precise implementation, and thorough validation
Validation requirements specify Python ruff check, TypeScript tsc --noEmit, and targeted testing
Debugging workflow emphasizes investigation before redesign with evidence-based findings
Quality bar prioritizes maintainability, reliability, minimal diffs, and complete architecture changes
Response style contract specifies outcome-first reporting and technical fidelity preservation
Budget guidance provides complexity-based response patterns for simple, auto, and complex modes
